emergence.summary: An X-linked progressive chorioretinal degeneration. Loss-of-function of CHM -- which encodes Rab Escort Protein 1 (REP1) -- removes a positive intracellular-maintenance DRIVE: REP1 presents newly synthesised Rab GTPases to Rab geranylgeranyl transferase for prenylation (geranylgeranylation), the lipid modification REQUIRED for Rab membrane attachment and vesicular trafficking. Without REP1 a subset of Rabs (notably Rab27a) is left under-prenylated; the autosomal paralogue REP2 (CHML) partially compensates in most tissues, which is WHY the lesion is largely restricted to the eye (retinal pigment epithelium, photoreceptors, choroid) where REP1 is rate-limiting -> progressive degeneration of choroid + RPE + photoreceptors -> night blindness in youth, concentric peripheral-field constriction, eventual central-vision loss. The disease is read as the photoreceptor/RPE Rab-prenylation / vesicular-trafficking maintenance throughput axis driven DOWN (a positive maintenance driver whose loss starves retinal homeostasis -- the drive-lost shape). This is the kit's THIRD OCULAR read and its THIRD distinct ocular GENE CLASS: where LCA2 (RPE65) is a retinoid-CYCLE ENZYME deficiency and XLRP (RPGR) is a ciliary-TRAFFICKING / outer-segment-maintenance deficiency, choroideremia (CHM/REP1) is a Rab-PRENYLATION / vesicular-trafficking maintenance deficiency -- three different molecular machines in the same retina, whose lead corrective lever is nonetheless the same class, gene restoration. Correction is to restore the gene at the locus: replace CHM (subretinal AAV2-REP1 gene transfer). IMPORTANT HONESTY: there is at present NO approved therapy for choroideremia. The lead clinical agent is timrepigene emparvovec (AAV2-REP1 / BIIB111), whose phase 3 STAR trial DID NOT MEET its primary endpoint AND did not demonstrate efficacy on key secondary endpoints, so the kit ships this read in the SAME honest pattern as Huntington disease and XLRP (a DNA-readable disease whose lead gene-replacement agent is genuinely clinical-not-approved). The firewall makes this clean: the emerged switch FORCES the corrective DIRECTION = restore CHM/REP1 [F], which the lead agent matches; the EFFICACY / MAGNITUDE is [O] -- and the STAR primary/secondary-endpoint result is exactly a magnitude question, recorded honestly, not asserted. Antioxidant / vitamin supplementation is a supportive NON-lever (does not halt the degeneration). The gamma read is of the CHM locus switch STRUCTURE (Xq21.2, AT-leaning); the disease lesions are predominantly nonsense / frameshift / splice coding changes, outside the promoter firewall. X-linked (hemizygous males affected; carrier females show patchy fundus changes by X-inactivation, held [O]). Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: photoreceptor / RPE / choroid Rab-prenylation-dependent intracellular vesicular-trafficking maintenance (REP1-supported Rab geranylgeranylation) -- a THIRD ocular axis, the Rab-prenylation/vesicular-trafficking contrast to LCA2's retinoid-cycle enzyme axis and XLRP's ciliary-trafficking axis

per_gene.note: CHM encodes Rab Escort Protein 1 (REP1), which presents nascent Rab GTPases to Rab geranylgeranyl transferase (RGGT) for prenylation -- the obligate lipid modification that lets Rabs associate with membranes and drive vesicular trafficking -- a positive maintenance DRIVE for retinal/RPE homeostasis. LOF (nonsense / frameshift / splice alleles) leaves a subset of Rabs (esp. Rab27a) under-prenylated; REP2 (CHML) partially substitutes elsewhere, so degeneration is largely confined to choroid, RPE and photoreceptors -> choroideremia. Located Xq21.2. NCBI official symbol CHM. X-linked. Coding lesions; promoter firewall respected.
per_gene.src: Cremers 1990 Nature 347:674 (CHM cloned); Seabra 1992 Science 256:484 / Seabra 1993 (REP1 is the Rab escort component of Rab geranylgeranyl transferase); van Bokhoven 1994 Hum Mol Genet 3:1041 (CHM mutation spectrum -- predominantly null alleles)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: restore CHM / REP1 expression in retinal cells -> re-establish Rab prenylation and vesicular trafficking (axis UP toward maintenance)
levers.agent_class: subretinal AAV2-REP1 gene transfer (timrepigene emparvovec / BIIB111)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored REP1 / Rab-prenylation / photoreceptor-survival magnitude not derived from sequence -- and NOT approved: the phase 3 STAR trial did not meet its primary endpoint and did not demonstrate efficacy on key secondary endpoints (a magnitude question); named here as the lead clinical agent (the Huntington/XLRP-pattern honest read), efficacy held [O]
levers.src: Biogen STAR phase 3 (NCT03496012) topline 2021 -- did not meet primary or key secondary endpoints; MacLaren 2014 Lancet 383:1129 (first choroideremia gene-therapy trial); Xue 2018 Nat Med 24:1507 (REP1 gene therapy phase 1/2 functional signals). No approved choroideremia therapy as of 2026

falsifiers.falsifier: a CHM LOF allele that PRESERVED or IMPROVED Rab prenylation / photoreceptor-RPE survival would refute the drive-lost (axis DOWN) direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: Rab27a prenylation state, RPE/photoreceptor survival and ERG in Chm-mutant retina (Chm-null mouse / zebrafish, patient)

falsifiers.claim: restoring CHM / REP1 (replace) is the CORRECTIVE direction
